title: Slushie Bar Salts Cotton Candy Ice 10ml E-Liquid
description: Slushie Bar Salts' Cotton Candy Ice is a nostalgic journey with a cool twist. This e-liquid captures the delightful essence of fluffy, sweet Cotton Candy, infused with an icy exhale for an added layer of refreshment. Each draw envelops your senses in the sugary bliss of carnival-style cotton candy, evoking memories of funfairs and summertime treats. The experience is further elevated by the cooling sensation that follows. This icy layer complements the sweetness of the cotton candy, creating a balanced and endlessly enjoyable vaping experience. It's like enjoying your favourite childhood treat with a refreshing new dimension. This premium e-liquid’s 50VG/50PG blend hits the sweet spot between flavour and cloud production and the unique nicotine salt solution makes it ideal for use in classic e-cigarette starter kits and pod devices. Perfect for recent ex-smokers or vapers seeking the immediate, satisfying nicotine relief provided by nic salts. If you enjoy this flavour, there are plenty more Slushie Bar Salts flavours to try. Few e-liquid makers have mastered the icy joys of slushy flavours quite like Slushie, a UK company who are behind an irresistible line of 50ml and 100ml shortfill and Nic Salts e-liquids that blend mouth-watering fruit flavours with healthy doses of icy menthol for an unparalleled slushy vaping experience. We’re also thrilled to stock new Slushy Bar Salts: Nic Salt e-liquids that capture the intense flavour and satisfaction of your favourite disposable vape flavours in handy 10ml bottles for use with a wide variety of MTL (mouth-to-lung) vape kits.
